name: S&P 500
description: Stock market index of 500 large US companies, weighted by market value. Daily adjusted close from Yahoo Finance.

name: Dow Jones
description: Price-weighted stock market index of 30 large US companies. Daily adjusted close from Yahoo Finance.

name: NASDAQ
description: Index of the stocks listed on the Nasdaq exchange, weighted by market value. Daily adjusted close from Yahoo Finance.

name: Hang Seng Index
description: Index of the largest companies listed in Hong Kong. Daily adjusted close from Yahoo Finance.

name: CSI 300 China Tracker
description: Hong Kong-listed ETF tracking the CSI 300 index of large companies on the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges. Daily adjusted close from Yahoo Finance; history from 2024.

name: MSCI AC World ETF
description: UCITS ETF tracking the MSCI All Country World Index of large and mid-cap stocks in developed and emerging markets, traded on Xetra in euros. Daily adjusted close from Yahoo Finance.

name: US Dollar Index
description: Value of the US dollar against a weighted basket of six major currencies. Daily adjusted close from Yahoo Finance.

name: Gold
description: Front-month COMEX gold futures price. Daily close from Yahoo Finance.

name: Crude Oil (WTI)
description: West Texas Intermediate crude oil spot price at Cushing, Oklahoma. Daily, from the US Energy Information Administration via FRED.

name: Copper
description: Global price of copper, monthly average. From the IMF via FRED.

name: Bitcoin
description: Bitcoin price in US dollars on Coinbase, daily including weekends. From Coinbase via FRED.

name: Real GDP
description: Total output of the US economy, adjusted for inflation, at a seasonally adjusted annual rate. Quarterly, from the Bureau of Economic Analysis via FRED.

name: Home Price Index
description: Repeat-sales index of US single-family home prices, seasonally adjusted. Monthly, from S&P Dow Jones Indices via FRED.

name: Inflation Rate
description: Change in consumer prices over the previous 12 months, from the seasonally adjusted Consumer Price Index for all urban consumers. Monthly, from the Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED.

name: Consumer Prices Denmark
description: Harmonised index of consumer prices for Denmark, all items. Monthly, from Eurostat via FRED.

name: Unemployment Rate
description: Share of the labor force that is jobless and looking for work, seasonally adjusted. Monthly, from the Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED.

name: Labor Force Participation
description: Share of the civilian population aged 16 and over that is working or looking for work, seasonally adjusted. Monthly, from the Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED.

name: Federal Funds Rate
description: Effective federal funds rate, the overnight rate between US banks targeted by the Federal Reserve. Monthly average, via FRED.

name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
description: Market yield on US Treasury securities with 10 years to maturity. Daily, from the Federal Reserve via FRED.

name: Federal Debt to GDP
description: Total public debt of the US federal government as a share of GDP, seasonally adjusted. Quarterly, from the Office of Management and Budget and the St. Louis Fed via FRED.
